# page-flip (StPageFlip) — vendored asset

`page-flip.browser.min.js` is **page-flip 2.0.7** by Oleg Litovski (Nodlik), MIT
licensed. The browser build self-injects its required CSS at runtime, so no
separate stylesheet is needed.

This file is bundled into the site's fingerprint-minified JS bundle by
`layouts/_default/baseof.html` (via `resources.Concat`).

Source: https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
